resources.string: Your study notes, on your lock screen
Facts Wallpaper turns your PDFs and textbooks into a quiet rotation of facts, formulas and diagrams. No account, no cloud, everything stays on this device.
Works offline once your facts exist
Every card keeps its book and page provenance
Your library and keys stay local
Facts are generated with the provider you choose. You can add more profiles and route each task separately later.
Keys will be sealed in the Android Keystore. Key storage ships with the AI phase.
Secure key storage arrives with the AI phase.
Connection testing arrives with the AI phase.
Import a textbook or lecture notes. The library can hold your whole study shelf, and only selected facts join the wallpaper rotation.
The app theme and the wallpaper theme are independent. Choose what feels comfortable for reading and for your lock screen.
Card templates arrive with the rendering phase. You can choose one later in Template Gallery.
Launch the Android live wallpaper picker and choose Facts Wallpaper. You can change the schedule, template and rotation order at any time.
Setup is saved on this device. You can revisit every step from Settings.

Setup complete. Your library is ready.
